sections.title: The offering described
sections.text: The website discusses reaching prospective clients through other people’s audiences and presents coaching around offers and client acquisition. The event material demonstrates a training format used by the business. These sources establish the advertised subject matter, but their promotional examples do not prove a typical result or the performance of a future engagement.

sections.title: A business model rather than a universal rule
sections.text: Coaching, training and an individual marketing campaign are distinct things. A founder’s explanation can clarify the business’s emphasis without establishing which activity a particular customer should buy. Before evaluating an engagement, a reader needs the actual scope, delivery format, responsibilities and terms rather than a headline from an event page.

sections.title: What this entry leaves unassessed
sections.text: No financial figures from the marketing examples are used to qualify the company, estimate the founder’s income or predict a customer outcome. The profile also does not establish current participation by any named customer. It gives a source trail for Harris’s founder role and the company’s stated area of work, with the source review date kept visible.
